title: events-admin-tab-scheduled-jobs.html
content: Use the buttons on the Scheduled Jobs tab to schedule a variety of jobs. If a new scheduled job is added to Events, all you need to do is click one of the following buttons instead of manually scheduling the job from a particular apex class. Schedule Recommended Event Jobs Use the Schedule Recommended Event Jobs button to schedule all of our recommended Event batch jobs including those that were manually unscheduled. You can find the scheduled jobs in Setup > Jobs > Scheduled Jobs. {{snippet.Events_ChangeScheduledApexUser}} Blackthorn | Events Process No-Show Attendees Runs nightly at 11:00 pm. Updates an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} to "No-Show" if the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} has passed and the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} is NOT "Attended". This feature can be enabled with the {{variable.Field_ETSettings_AutoUpdNoShow}} field. Blackthorn | Events Attendee Parent Rollup Runs nightly at 2:00 am. Updates the {{variable.Field_Contact_EventsAttended}} roll-up field on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s parent objects (i.e., {{variable.Object_Lead}} or {{variable.Object_Contact}} ) based on the count of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s with {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = "Attended". The {{variable.Button_ScheduleRecommEventJobs}} button schedules the AttendeeRollupToParent batch and sets the chunk size to 50,000 records. If you need to decrease the chunk size, use the Schedule Attendee Parent Rollup Job button. Blackthorn | Events Form Submission Processing Runs at the top of each hour (12:00, 1:00, 2:00, etc.) Processes {{variable.Object_FormSubmissionAnswer}} s and links them to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} , {{variable.Object_Contact}} , {{variable.Object_Account}} , or {{variable.Object_Lead}} based on the {{variable.Object_FormElement}} s’ mapping requirements. Blackthorn | Events Geocode Service Runs nightly at 10:00 pm. Updates the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenueAddrGeocode}} field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record based on the Venue’s provided address. Blackthorn | Event Webinar Account Refresh Apex Class Job: WebinarAccountAuthRefresh Runs daily at 2:00 am. Ensures the webinar account refresh token does not expire. Blackthorn | Events Recurring Event Generate Runs nightly at 3:00 am. Updates and creates {{variable.Object_RecurringEvent}} s when {{variable.Field_RecEvents_RecurrenceMeth}} = "Keep One Open" or "Auto-Renew." Blackthorn | Events Status Update Runs nightly at 1:00 am. If there are more than 1,500 active {{variable.Object_Event}} s, this job updates any {{variable.Object_Event}} where the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventEndDate}} is in the past. It unpublishes the {{variable.Object_Event}} and updates the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} to "Completed." Blackthorn | Batch Event Registration Submission Runs every minute. Since this job processes {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} records in batches, there may be a delay of up to one minute before a record is processed. Blackthorn | Events Revenue Rollups Once an {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Status}} = “Ended”, the job will run, rolling up {{variable.Object_EventItem}} and {{variable.Object_Event}} financial summaries. Schedule Event Cache Refresh Job Click the Schedule Event Cache Refresh Job button to schedule the cache refresh batch to run periodically. Are you using Caching 2.0? If you are using Caching 2.0, you must disable the Schedule Event Cache Refresh job. To turn off the job, click the Disable Event Cache Refresh Job button. Blackthorn | Events Cache Refresh This job schedules a cache refresh to run periodically and will refresh the cache to avoid any front-end caching issues. Schedule Attendee Parent Rollup Job The Schedule Attendee Parent Rollup Job button is on the Scheduled Jobs tab in the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. The Blackthorn | Events Attendee Parent Rollup job updates the {{variable.Field_Contact_EventsAttended}} roll-up field on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s parent object ( {{variable.Object_Lead}} or {{variable.Object_Contact}} ) based on the count of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s with {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = "Attended." Blackthorn | Events Attendee Parent Rollup If your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object includes a lot of custom fields and the AttendeeRollupToParent batch job is performed, a batch size of 50,000 can result in errors due to governor limits (i.e., heap size memory exceeded errors). Use the {{variable.Field_SchedJob_BatchChunkSize}} field and Schedule Attendee Parent Rollup Job button to reschedule and decrease the size of the batch job, which will help prevent this error; otherwise, use the Schedule Recommended Event Jobs button. After the job is executed, users can go to the AttendeeRollupToParent Apex Job in Setup to confirm that {{variable.Field_SF_TotalBatches}} equals the number of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s divided by the {{variable.Field_SchedJob_BatchChunkSize}} . The job checks all records that are linked to a {{variable.Object_Lead}} or {{variable.Object_Contact}} and have the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} = “Attended,” but it only updates the {{variable.Object_Lead}} or {{variable.Object_Contact}} ’s {{variable.Field_Contact_EventsAttended}} count if the count has changed since the job last ran. Schedule Advanced Visibility Jobs The Schedule Advanced Visibility Jobs button is on the Scheduled Jobs tab in the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. The button only appears to users with the {{variable.PS_ET_Admin}} permission set. The Schedule Advanced Visibility Jobs button will only appear on the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab when the {{variable.CS_EnableAdvancedVisibility}} custom setting is set to “True.” Blackthorn | Base Adv Visibility Hourly Sync To activate this scheduled job, set the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} ’s {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field to "True" (checked) and the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field to the current date and time. The job will now run once an hour. Going forward, when a user creates or updates a {{variable.Object_BTRule}} or {{variable.Object_BTRuleCondition}} record, the job will check the date/time in the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} field, looking for records with a {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} after the scheduled job's start date/time. If the {{variable.Field_BTRule_LastUpdateDate}} is before the scheduled job's start date, the {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} field will be set to "False." NOTE: Setting {{variable.Object_BTRule}} {{variable.Field_BTRule_Process}} = "True" (checked) will not cause the {{variable.Object_BTRule}} to be processed immediately. It will be processed during the next scheduled run.
